# ARCH Revenues — Comprehensive Guide for AI & Search Agents

## Project Overview
ARCH Revenues (https://www.archrevenues.com) builds and runs done-for-you outbound acquisition systems designed specifically for founder-led marketing, design, and software development agencies targeting clients in the US, UK, Australia, and Canada.

- Founder: Shivam Sharma
- Primary Email: shivam@archrevenues.com
- Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India
- Positioning: Done-for-you cold email + LinkedIn multi-channel outreach for founder-led agencies booking 5-12 qualified sales demos per month.

---

## Deliverables & Service Scope
1. **ICP & Data Sourcing:** Definition of target account filters and creation of verified lead lists (up to 300 accounts per month) using Apollo and custom enrichment.
2. **Infrastructure Buildout:** 3 dedicated sending domains, Google Workspace inboxes, full DNS authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), domain rotation, and 14-day inbox warmup.
3. **Multi-Channel Sequence Creation:** AI-assisted personalized cold email copy and LinkedIn outreach sequences tailored to agency offers.
4. **Campaign Execution & Inbox Management:** Daily automated outreach (90-150 emails/day), reply triage, and positive response handling within 4 business hours.
5. **Weekly Reporting:** Every Monday, detailed report on email delivery rates, open rates, reply rates, and booked meetings.

---

## Pricing & Performance Pilot
- **Founding Client Rate:** $499 one-time setup fee + $1,499/month retainer (locked for 90 days, capped at 3 spots).
- **Standard Retainer:** $4,000/month after founding spots are claimed.
- **Guarantee:** If fewer than 5 qualified demos are booked in any billing month, the monthly retainer for that month is refunded in full. Setup fee is non-refundable.
- **Definition of Qualified Demo:** Prospect matching agreed ICP parameters who attends the scheduled video call. No-shows do not count.
- **Contract Terms:** No annual contract lock-in. Cancel anytime after the initial 30 days.

---

## Free Online Tools & Resources
- **AI Cold Email Generator:** https://www.archrevenues.com/tools/email-generator
  - Allows visitors to enter their offer description and a prospect URL. Uses AI scraping & analysis to draft customized outreach messages.
- **ICP Audit Worksheet:** https://www.archrevenues.com/audit
  - Interactive self-serve audit for agency founders to refine target audience positioning.

---

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
- **Q: How many demos are guaranteed?**
  A: Target is 5 to 12 qualified demos per month. Fewer than 5 in any month triggers a full monthly retainer refund.
- **Q: How fast do initial results start?**
  A: Infrastructure setup and inbox warmup take 14-21 days. First meetings land in weeks 3 to 4.
- **Q: Who provides the lead lists?**
  A: ARCH Revenues builds and verifies target lead lists directly; client approval is obtained before launching campaigns.
- **Q: What is the cancellation policy?**
  A: Month-to-month commitment after the first 30 days. Cancel with written notice before the next billing date.
